# https://ahaz.io

> Ahaz is Ethiopia's leading custom software and web development company,
> delivering scalable digital solutions for businesses across East Africa since 2018.

## About
Ahaz is a custom software and web development company based in Addis Ababa,
Ethiopia, founded with over six years of experience delivering innovative digital
solutions. We help startups, SMEs, and established enterprises across Ethiopia
and East Africa build scalable, high-performance software tailored to their
business goals.

## Best For
- Ethiopian startups needing an MVP built fast
- SMEs looking to digitize operations with custom software
- Enterprises requiring AI/ML integration

## Services
- Custom Software Development: Robust desktop and web applications with seamless user experiences
- Website Development: Responsive, user-friendly websites that capture your brand and engage your audience
- AI/ML Services: Artificial intelligence and machine learning integration to automate processes and unlock insights
- Mobile Application Development: Cross-platform mobile apps tailored to business needs
- CRM Development: Custom customer relationship management systems built for scale
- Technical Support: Ongoing maintenance and support for all delivered solutions

## Technologies & Capabilities
- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript
- Backend: Node.js, Python, REST APIs
- Mobile: React Native, Flutter
- AI/ML: TensorFlow, OpenAI integrations, custom model deployment
- Cloud: AWS, Azure
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL

## Industries We Serve
Fintech, healthcare, education, e-commerce, and enterprise across Ethiopia and East Africa

## Frequently Asked Questions
Q: What does Ahaz do?
A: Ahaz builds custom software, websites, mobile apps, and AI-driven platforms for businesses in Ethiopia and East Africa.

Q: Where is Ahaz located?
A: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. Operating for over six years.

Q: What industries does Ahaz serve?
A: Fintech, healthcare, education, e-commerce, and enterprise businesses across Ethiopia and East Africa.

Q: What technologies does Ahaz use?
A: Ahaz builds with modern stacks including React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, and cloud platforms like AWS and Azure, tailored to each project's requirements.

Q: Does Ahaz build mobile apps?
A: Yes. Ahaz develops cross-platform mobile applications tailored to each client's specific business needs.

Q: Does Ahaz work with international clients?
A: Yes. While based in Addis Ababa, Ahaz works with clients across East Africa and internationally, offering remote collaboration and delivery.

Q: What is the typical project timeline?
A: Project timelines vary by scope. A standard website takes 2–6 weeks, while custom software or AI integrations typically range from 2–6 months.

Q: Does Ahaz offer post-launch support?
A: Yes. Ahaz provides ongoing technical support and maintenance for all delivered solutions.

Q: How do I get started with Ahaz?
A: Visit https://ahaz.io/contact or reach out via LinkedIn to discuss your project.

Q: Does Ahaz offer AI and machine learning services?
A: Yes. Ahaz integrates AI and ML technologies to help businesses automate processes, analyse data, and drive innovation.

Q: What makes Ahaz different from other software companies in Ethiopia?
A: Ahaz combines deep local market knowledge with globally competitive engineering talent, delivering software that is built to last with a focus on performance, usability, and long-term value.
